sourceInterface.qualification: actual private frozen approved-job storage context, current real job/code/Node/owner/guest-volume/image, frozen qualified inputs, exact original five-field sourceArtifact
sourceInterface.fileChecks: declared single source only; canonical path/root, no symlink in file or parents, regular file, actual device, exact byte size, streamed SHA, stable ino/dev/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs; copy boundaries recheck same immutable pin

inputChecks: normal preparation identity/sourceOrigin/source registration and declared guest placement agree with media map
normal draft, all its request target URIs, transcript URI, source ID/ref, logical path, file hash and size agree
provenance record and original/GPU/normal companion JSON read through unchanged logical repo binding route
existing normal public provenance validator checks exact record/owners/URIs/three logical refs/raw input source SHA and bytes; original versus normal transcript differs only at sourceUri

tests.scope: pure metadata/provenance validation and actual private-entry fake-context rejection; 1KiB filesystem unit observer tests exported from a temporary test copy only
tests.limits: Filesystem unit positive uses a test-only current callback and actual small files/dev/stat/hash; it does not mint a private job/storage/source capability or verify the actual 1GB SSD material.

internal.inputs: repository JSON snapshots, normal plan/transcript/provenance/mapping/candidate/settings records; sizes must use actual record stats
internal.sourceRead: stream hash/stat only; no full media readFile or media write in these two paths
internal.correction: The previous scratch plan would manually copy the SSD media into repo and normal prepare would make a second repo media copy. Core snapshot was already guest; attributing the second internal copy to Core was incorrect.

guest.sourceOriginal: retained declared source (root reported actual 1016332396 bytes)
guest.coreSnapshot: one owned snapshot on guest; same source bytes checked before/after copying and output SHA before media processing
guest.otherOutputs: source grid/video/PCM, base output, overlays, composition, QC and temp in existing guest output root; their actual clock/unit size and explicit budgets govern capacity
guest.formulaPurpose: exact source snapshot and explicit uncompressed audio buffers only; compressed video/image/JSON allocations require separate actual-size/budget estimates and live next-unit-plus-reserve checks

capacityByVolume.host: sparsebundle backing growth plus explicit hostMetadataReserveBytes; do not add host free bytes to guest/internal free bytes

remaining: Parent to qualify the real newly saved normal input bundle and actual production owner/storage/source context.
No actual video generation or full-engine/hardware success is claimed by these tests.
